The 3 `camera` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## camera.focus

Points the editor camera at entities (with their descendants) and backs it off until their bounds fit the view, keeping its orientation; without entities it frames the whole scene. No undo step. Returns the camera like camera.get.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `viewport` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorViewportCommands.cpp:1081`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entities to frame (default: every active entity) (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |

## camera.get

The editor camera: position, target (orbit pivot), forward direction, yaw and pitch in degrees, distance to the target, vertical field of view, clip planes and fly speed.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Session` · MCP toolsets: `viewport` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorViewportCommands.cpp:1008`

No parameters.

<details>
<summary>Parameter schema of camera.get</summary>

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

## camera.set

Moves or configures the editor camera (a view change: no undo step, the scene is unchanged). position + target looks from one point at the other; otherwise yaw/pitch orbit around the target, distance sets how far the camera is from it, and position or target moves the camera keeping its orientation. Returns the camera like camera.get.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `viewport` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorViewportCommands.cpp:1016`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `distance` | number | no |   | Distance from the camera to the target. Value: at least `0.009999999776482582`, at most `1000000.0`. |
| `far` | number | no |   | Far clip plane distance (above near). Value: at least `9.999999747378752e-05`, at most `10000000.0`. |
| `flySpeed` | number | no |   | Fly mode speed in units per second. Value: at least `0.009999999776482582`, at most `10000.0`. |
| `fov` | number | no |   | Vertical field of view in degrees. Value: at least `1.0`, at most `170.0`. |
| `near` | number | no |   | Near clip plane distance. Value: at least `9.999999747378752e-05`, at most `10000000.0`. |
| `pitch` | number | no |   | Degrees up (positive) or down (negative). Value: at least `-89.0`, at most `89.0`. |
| `position` | array of number | no |   | Camera position in world space. Items: at least 3, at most 3. |
| `target` | array of number | no |   | Point the camera looks at and orbits around. Items: at least 3, at most 3. |
| `yaw` | number | no |   | Degrees around world +Y; 0 looks along -Z, 90 along -X. Value: at least `-1000000.0`, at most `1000000.0`. |
